material.description: Ubiquitous Language (P2). Suppressing automatic bundle/runner updates is named no-self-update in the on-disk marker and env (NO_SELF_UPDATE_FILE 'gm-mcp-server.no-self-update' and RUNNER_FREEZE_FILE 'agentplug-runner.no-self-update', GM_MCP_NO_SELF_UPDATE and RUNNER_FREEZE_ENV), in AGENTS.md, and in the self-update verb name. The code names the same concept freeze: selfUpdateFreezeReason and bridgeFreezeReason in gm-mcp/src/self-update.js:48 and gm-mcp/src/release-bridge.js:164, the frozen locals at self-update.js:219 and release-bridge.js:294, and the frozen_by / 'freeze state' output in self-update.js:153 and cli.js:218. Decision recorded: no-self-update is the ubiquitous term because it names the marker and env the operator types. Change: rename the code identifiers to noSelfUpdate* (selfUpdateFreezeReason -> selfUpdateSuppressedReason is NOT the choice; use noSelfUpdateReason, bridgeNoSelfUpdateReason, and frozen -> suppressed) in gm-mcp/src/self-update.js, gm-mcp/src/release-bridge.js and the cli.js help and status text. The wire field frozen_by is a user-visible output key and is NOT renamed here; that choice is a mutable for the user. Witness: grep for freeze in gm-mcp/src returns only frozen_by, and node gm-mcp/src/cli.js self-update-status prints the same reason text as before.
